intervention_A: Native original PICKUP key, original TOGGLE locked door using key, then native DROP key back to its source location. Evaluator temporarily sets player pose for the three source actions; this is not an uninterrupted naturally navigated agent episode.
control_B: At identical evaluator-staged poses run three native DROP actions without carried item; original door remains locked.
post_condition: Exact original world differences confined to the door's encoded tile; same key position, no item carried, same native step count.
pre_action: Bounded exhaustive lexicographic probe over identical evaluator-staged empty world positions, all four orientations and native action LEFT, RIGHT, FORWARD; require byte-identical current 7x7x3 public images and MR15 visible 24-byte samples, identical pre-action eight delta bits [0]*8 and original action.
post_action: Native original env.step emits actual public image. Count cases where next image differs and separately cases where original next 8 MR15 change bits differ. No hidden source state or object labels given to a learner.
positive_condition: At least one equal-current-public-image/action pair has different authentic next-public-source image and 8-bit MR15 outcome. If none, report a bounded negative with no seed search or retuning.
scientific_scope: This is an evaluator-staged source-native partial-observability witness, not trained causal memory, naturally navigated role specialization, transfer or independent heldout evaluation.
source_world_privileged_fields: Only diagnostic evaluator selects interventions and validates equal observable input and one-door world difference; no learner receives them.
